title: Vesper and the Semester
author: Jonah Dravenmoor
blurb: Noor Lockridge, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
